name: SB 612111
summary: SB-612,111 is an opioid receptor ligand which is a potent and selective antagonist for the nociceptin receptor (ORL-1), several times more potent than the older drug J-113,397. It does not have analgesic effects in its own right, but prevents the development of hyperalgesia, and also shows antidepressant effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: SB-612,111 is an opioid receptor ligand which is a potent and selective antagonist for the nociceptin receptor (ORL-1), several times more potent than the older drug J-113,397.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: SB-612111 blocks the nociceptin receptor, the fourth opioid receptor, found in 1994. Blocking it has been studied for depression, the opposite approach to the agonists tested for addiction.
fact.zh: SB-612111 阻斷痛敏肽受體，這是 1994 年發現的第四種鴉片受體。阻斷它曾被研究用於憂鬱症，和用促效劑治療成癮的方向正好相反。
fact.zhHans: SB-612111 阻断痛敏肽受体，这是 1994 年发现的第四种鸦片受体。阻断它曾被研究用于忧郁症，和用促效剂治疗成瘾的方向正好相反。
